summary: Ayurvedic-styled website project with WhatsApp button and admin panel. Currently fixing a bug where updating the WhatsApp number from the admin panel does not reflect in the WhatsApp button on the frontend.
architectural_notes: WhatsApp button must dynamically fetch phone number from backend canister, not use hardcoded or cached value
known_issues: WhatsApp button does not update when phone number is changed from admin panel — frontend not re-fetching updated value from backend after save

existing_features.title: The FloatingWhatsApp component must dynamically fetch the WhatsApp phone number from the backend canister (via the site settings query) instead of using a hardcoded or stale cached value. After the admin saves a new WhatsApp number in AdminSettings, the FloatingWhatsApp button must use the updated number immediately — ensure the React Query cache for site settings is invalidated or refetched after a successful save in AdminSettings so the customer-facing button always reflects the current backend value.
